metadata.subject: layout.typography.punctuationSpacing as an explicit PunctuationSpacingRule[] — house style instead of a preset (pdfnative 1.8.0)
metadata.keywords: typography, punctuation, spacing rules, house style, no-break space

blocks.text: A house style, rule by rule

punctuationSpacing takes a preset name ("fr", "fr-CA") or a list of rules. Each rule names a character, the side the space goes on (before or after) and its width: narrow is U+202F NARROW NO-BREAK SPACE, nbsp is U+00A0 NO-BREAK SPACE. An existing plain space on that side is replaced; nothing is inserted where no space was typed.

cells: 42 % never breaks between the figure and the sign

blocks.text: Humidity rose to 42 % while the room stayed at 21 °C — a comfortable reading, as § 6.2.2 of the building code requires — and the margin of error remained below 3 % over the whole period. None of these pairs can be split at the end of a line, however narrow the column.
